author: Rick Steves' Europe
description:
You don't always need music on the page to play a great tune! Rick Steves demonstrates how the blues scale can give musicians the tools they need to experiment, improvise, and create something all their own. Rick explores how a simple group of notes can unlock countless musical possibilities. Follow along and discover how improvisation turns playing the piano into a musical conversation.

title: Improvise on the Piano Like a Pro Using the Blues Scale

author: Rick Steves' Europe
description:
Can you hear where a piece of music comes from? Put your ears to the test as Rick Steves and Julie Spangler explore how composers incorporated the sounds, rhythms, dances, melodies, and traditions of European countries into their music. Listen for musical clues and discover how classical music can reflect the culture and identity of people and places around the world.

author: Rick Steves' Europe
description:
Breathtaking landscapes and the natural world became powerful sources of inspiration for composers during the 1800s. Through emotive examples on the piano, Rick Steves and Julie Spangler explore how Romantic-era composers looked to nature for musical inspiration. Hear how the piano can evoke everything from a peaceful fjord to the drama of a swarm of bumblebees — and discover why nature became such an important part of Romantic music and art.

Join Rick Steves for a closer look at one of the world's most versatile instruments. Explore the piano's keys, strings, hammers, pedals, and incredible range - and discover how a pianist uses them to turn notes on a page into expressive music.

Music and visual art may seem like completely different worlds, but throughout history, they've often evolved side by side. Join Rick Steves and Julie Spangler on a journey through artistic history as they connect music and art and how they have evolved throughout history. See how the same periods that inspired new styles of painting and architecture also gave composers new ways to express themselves through music.

Julie explores examples on the piano, discovering how composers use different musical tools to create emotions and tell a story.

author: Rick Steves' Europe
description:
For Rick Steves, the connection between music, travel, and culture is also deeply personal. Rick shares the story of his Uncle Thor from Norway and explores how family, heritage, and music can connect us to places far beyond our own communities. Together with pianist Julie Spangler, this story offers a personal look at the way music can preserve memories, celebrate cultural traditions, and help us better understand where we come from.

description:

Rick Steves and pianist Julie Spangler explore the intimate musical gatherings that became an important part of European cultural life - and hear how the piano became the perfect instrument for these spaces.
